notes: Program identity and rival coaches. Your program earns an identity from what it actually does over three seasons (Air raid, Ground and pound, Defense wins, QB factory, NFL pipeline, Giant killer, Portal U, Homegrown); it shows on the Program tab, recruits at matching positions warm faster and are tagged 'fits your identity', and it can be lost. Every opposing head coach now has a personality (Recruiter, Riverboat gambler, Old school, Players' coach, Showman, Schemer) that changes how they recruit, keep rosters, and play; it shows in the scouting report. Recruiter coaches work on your commits midseason: a wavering commit gets a warning and you can fly out, call the family, or promise playing time before he decides. Showmen talk at their pressers before your game and heat up rivalries.
